title: Besiktas vs Olympique: Europa League debut
seoTitle: Besiktas vs Olympique: Europa League Opener
subtitle: The clash marks the start of the continental campaign for the Turkish and French sides
excerpt: Besiktas kicks off the Europa League league phase against Olympique de Marseille in Istanbul at 4 PM.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Besiktas kicks off the Europa League league phase against Olympique de Marseille in Istanbul at 4 PM. The match, valid for the first round of the first phase, promises a decisive clash between rebuilding teams.

What changes in your pocket when Besiktas takes the field

The Turkish club arrives at the stadium with four consecutive wins in the Süper Lig, sitting in second place with nine points from four rounds. At home, the team has a perfect record: five matches, five wins, twelve goals scored, and only two conceded.

What changes in your pocket when Olympique de Marseille arrives

Olympique de Marseille, managed by Bruno Génésio, is in the midst of a turbulent period. Sitting fifth in Ligue 1, the club carries UEFA sanctions for Financial Fair Play violations, including a ten-million-euro fine and restrictions on player registration.

What changes in your pocket when the match takes place in Istanbul

The clash takes place at the Beşiktaş Stadium in Istanbul, the Tüpraş Stadyumu. The Turkish fans look to set a strong pace from the opening minutes to secure their first three points in the continental tournament.

What changes in your pocket when the match is available online

For those who cannot be at the stadium, the match can be watched live on Cazé TV on YouTube and on Prime Video, with 30 days free. Lance! will cover the match in real time.

What changes in your pocket when the result can be predicted

The odds reflect the expectation of a Besiktas victory, priced at 1.75. A draw is at 4.00, and an Olympique de Marseille win is at 4.20. The market also highlights the possibility of both teams scoring, with odds of 1.58.

With information from ge, Lance!, NETVASCO.
